title: 第11章 超古代海洋霸主的气魄第12章 拳力水准
slug: 从衔尾蛇石碑开始超凡
lines: 推门走进一号训练室，和学校教室差不多大小。
一张红木讲台，下方坐着三十几号人。
有相熟的在交谈，更多的则是在座位上默默翻看拳谱。
看了一眼训练室前方悬挂的钟表，08:25，时间还早。
找了个最后排角落靠窗的位置坐下，微风吹过窗外的绿化带，空气清新。
拿过《魄鲸拳》拳谱，直接翻开第一页，是一幅栩栩如生的图画。
一头赤色鲸鱼在轰烈暴风雨中跃出海面，像是要撞碎漫天乌云，看上去凶威赫赫。
图画下边有一行小字：
魄鲸拳，以超古代海洋霸主为源流，练就一股长鲸霸海的气魄！
“长鲸霸海......”他喃喃自语。
继续翻看，过了半个小时才缓缓抬起头，揉了揉眉心看向窗外，放松眼睛。
《魄鲸拳》并不复杂，只有十八式。
但重点在于这套拳法的每一式都有配套的呼吸节奏。
很有可能，这些呼吸节奏才是这套拳法的精华所在。
正想着，一阵闹铃声打断思绪。
回头望过去，声源是讲台上的一个铁制闹铃，指针指到九点整。
同时，他也注意到讲台旁不知道什么时候多了一道身影。
光头，身高近两米，身材雄壮，往那一站像堵墙似的。
身上的黑色练功服像是小了一号，双臂肌肉隆起，常人大腿那么粗，袖口都要撑裂开。
粗壮的手掌轻轻按上闹铃，声音戛然而止。
壮汉看着众人，咧嘴一笑，脖子上的肌肉跟着牵动。
“同学们好，我是你们的教练，雷龙。”
中气十足的声音一听就感觉充满力量。
实际上也是，林野打量着雷龙，这体格少说得三百斤。
就是不知道是不是那个说出‘战斗爽’的教练了。
讲台旁，雷龙目光扫视众人，而后取出一个金丝半框眼镜戴上。
整个人的气质都变得优雅内敛起来，有种西装暴徒的感觉。
“那么，我们正式上课，这节入门课总共分为两个部分。”
“第一部分是讲一讲拳法层次，让你们有个大概的认知。第二部分则由我带着你们练一遍魄鲸拳。”
说完，他拿起粉笔在黑板上写字，字体很漂亮。
‘一二三四五’
“拳法层次其实很简单，总共五层。”
“等你练出气感的时候，拳法就算是入门了，第一层也就成了。”
“一般来说，如果超过三个月还没有感受到气感，那就说明魄鲸拳不太适合你。”
林野微微挑眉，不太适合？
大概是照顾学员感受才这么说的，应该就是资质不行的意思。
“剩下的其实就没什么好说的了，到了那一步自然明白。”
content_en:
Push the door and walk into training room No. 1, which is about the same size as a school classroom.
There is a mahogany podium with more than thirty people sitting below it.
Some acquaintances were chatting, and more were silently reading boxing records in their seats.
I glanced at the clock hanging in front of the training room. It was 08:25, which was still early.
I found a seat in the corner of the last row and sat down by the window. The breeze blew through the green belt outside the window, and the air was fresh.
I took the "Soul Whale Fist" boxing manual and turned directly to the first page, which was a lifelike picture.
A red whale jumped out of the sea in the violent storm, as if it was about to smash through the dark clouds in the sky, looking fierce and majestic.
There is a line of small words below the picture:
Soul Whale Fist is based on the ultra-ancient ocean overlord, and has developed the courage to dominate the sea like a long whale!
"The long whale dominates the sea..." he murmured to himself.
I continued to read, and after half an hour I slowly raised my head, rubbed my brows, looked out the window, and relaxed my eyes.
"Soul Whale Fist" is not complicated, with only eighteen moves.
But the point is that each style of this boxing technique has a matching breathing rhythm.
It is very possible that these breathing rhythms are the essence of this boxing technique.
“Ring ring ring—!”
Just as he was thinking, his thoughts were interrupted by the sound of an alarm bell.
Looking back, I saw that the source of the sound was an iron alarm clock on the podium, and the hand pointed to nine o'clock.
At the same time, he also noticed that there was a figure beside the podium.
Bald, nearly two meters tall, and with a majestic build, he stood like a wall.
The black training clothes he wore seemed to be one size too small, and the muscles in his arms were bulging. They were as thick as an ordinary person's thighs, and the cuffs would burst.
A thick palm gently pressed the alarm, and the sound stopped suddenly.
The strong man looked at the crowd, grinned, and the muscles in his neck twitched.
"Hello students, I am your coach, Brontosaurus."
The powerful voice makes you feel full of power as soon as you hear it.
In fact, it was the same. Lin Ye looked at the Thunder Dragon. This physique weighed at least three hundred kilograms.
I just don’t know if he’s the coach who said, ‘Fighting is fun’.
Beside the podium, Thunder Dragon glanced at everyone, then took out a pair of gold-rimmed half-rim glasses and put them on.
His whole temperament became elegant and restrained, giving him the feeling of a thug in a suit.
"Then, let's officially start the class. This introductory class is divided into two parts."
"The first part is to talk about the levels of boxing to give you a general understanding. In the second part, I will lead you to practice the Soul Whale Fist."
After speaking, he picked up the chalk and wrote on the blackboard. The handwriting was beautiful.
‘One, two, three, four, five’
"The levels of boxing are actually very simple, there are five levels in total."
"When you develop the sense of Qi, the boxing technique will be considered an introduction and the first level will be completed."
"Generally speaking, if you still don't feel Qi after three months, it means that Po Whale Fist is not suitable for you."
Lin Ye raised his eyebrows slightly, not suitable?
He probably said this out of consideration for the students' feelings, and it probably meant that he was not qualified enough.
"There's really nothing else to say about the rest. You'll understand it when you get to that point."
